note: Every refusal token a conformance corpus row may record, with its meaning. A row records refused:<token>, and all three SDKs report the token through their public errors, so a replay compares it as it is. A token is added in the change that first records it and removed when no row records it. ADR-002 holds the rules.

reasons.bad_covered_components: The signature does not cover the components the profile requires, or covers one the request does not carry, so its signature base cannot be rebuilt.
reasons.bad_signature_agent: The request carries no Signature-Agent member the signature names, or one the profile refuses.
reasons.bad_tag: The signature's tag parameter is not web-bot-auth.
reasons.expired: The signed URL's exp time is before the verifier's clock.
reasons.missing_sig: There is no signature to verify: the request carries no Signature-Input or Signature header, or the URL has no sig parameter.
reasons.pop_expired: The delivery proof's expires time is not after the verifier's clock.
reasons.signature_mismatch: The signed URL's signature does not verify over its bytes with the key.
reasons.thumbprint_mismatch: The JWK thumbprint of the presented key is not the agent_id the URL is bound to.
reasons.unsupported_alg: The signature names an algorithm other than ed25519.
